canonical_name: Chernoff exponential-moment upper-tail bound for a finite independent sum
canonical_statement: For a finite family of independent real random variables X_i on a probability space, if their relevant exponential moments exist, then for every real threshold a and every real t > 0, the probability that their sum is at least a is at most exp(-t a) times the product of E[exp(t X_i)].
